taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name shown at top of form is not represented as a standalone canonical element in this schema; no matching candidate exists.

taxpayer_ssn.rationale: Taxpayer SSN at top of form is not represented as a standalone canonical element in this schema; no matching candidate exists.

part1_checkbox.rationale: Blueprint bundles all Part I checkbox options into a single category field, but the canonical schema splits each option into separate boolean indicators (e.g., Primary65OrOlderInd, BothSpouses65OrOlderInd, BothUnder65BothRtdDsbltyInd, etc.); blueprint should be refactored into individual boolean fields matching each canonical indicator.

taxpayer_physician_statement.rationale: PriorYearStatementInd is the closest canonical element for the physician/disability statement indicator; the personFirstNm attribute suggests it applies to the primary taxpayer.

spouse_physician_statement.rationale: No distinct canonical element exists for the spouse's physician statement separately from the primary taxpayer's; PriorYearStatementInd with @spouseNm attribute does not clearly represent this boolean indicator as a standalone field.

line_10_initial_amount.rationale: FilingStatusAmt corresponds to the initial base dollar amount determined by filing status/Part I box, which is Line 10 on Schedule R.

line_11a_disability_income_taxpayer.rationale: TaxableDisabilityAmt corresponds to taxable disability income, which aligns with Line 11a for the taxpayer's disability income.

line_11b_disability_income_spouse.rationale: No separate canonical element exists for the spouse's disability income (Line 11b); TaxableDisabilityAmt appears to cover only the combined or primary value, and no spouse-specific variant is present in the candidate list.

line_12_smaller_of_10_or_11.rationale: SmallerOfFSOrTaxableAmt directly names the Line 12 computation — the smaller of the filing status amount (Line 10) or taxable disability income (Line 11).

line_13a_agi.rationale: TaxReturnAGIAmt corresponds to the AGI from Form 1040 entered on Line 13a of Schedule R.

line_13b_nontaxable_social_security.rationale: NontxSocSecAndRlrdBenefitsAmt directly matches Line 13b — nontaxable Social Security and railroad retirement benefits.

line_13c_combined_income.rationale: TotalNontaxableAmt corresponds to Line 13c, the combined total of AGI and nontaxable benefits used for the phase-out calculation.

line_14_phaseout_threshold.rationale: ExemptionAmt corresponds to the Line 14 phase-out threshold amount based on filing status on Schedule R.

line_15_excess_agi.rationale: AdjustedGrossIncomeAmt in this context corresponds to Line 15 — the excess of combined income over the phase-out threshold.

line_16_half_excess.rationale: HalfAGIAmt directly corresponds to Line 16 — one-half of the excess AGI phase-out amount.

line_17_credit_base.rationale: AdjustedCreditAmt corresponds to Line 17 — the net credit base after subtracting the AGI phase-out reduction from Line 12.

line_18_credit_percentage.rationale: The 15% statutory rate is a printed constant on the form and is not represented as a data element in the canonical schema.

line_19_tentative_credit.rationale: CalculatedAmountOfNetCreditAmt corresponds to Line 19 — the tentative credit computed as Line 17 multiplied by 15%.

line_20_tax_liability_limit.rationale: TotalTaxLessCreditsAmt corresponds to Line 20 — the tax liability limitation from the Credit Limit Worksheet.

line_21_credit.rationale: CreditForElderlyOrDisabledAmt directly corresponds to Line 21 — the final Credit for the Elderly or the Disabled, the smaller of Line 19 or Line 20.
